comparison: vector Top 5 vs the same vector Top 20 reranked to Top 5

metric_definitions.document_recall_at_5: Fraction of distinct gold report IDs found in the first 5 chunks; macro per question.
metric_definitions.all_documents_hit_at_5: One if all distinct gold report IDs appear in the first 5 chunks, else zero.
metric_definitions.evidence_recall_at_5: Fraction of canonical gold source units fully covered by the union of the first 5 chunks; macro per question.
metric_definitions.evidence_hit_at_5: One if the first 5 chunks jointly cover any complete canonical gold source unit, else zero.
metric_definitions.all_evidence_hit_at_5: One if the first 5 chunks jointly cover every required evidence unit; an annotated-evidence answerability proxy, not generated-answer accuracy.
metric_definitions.annotated_evidence_precision_at_5: Number of the first 5 chunks that individually cover at least one complete canonical gold source unit, divided by 5. Missing result slots count as nonrelevant; unjudged valid evidence receives no credit.
metric_definitions.document_accuracy_at_1: One if the first chunk's report ID is a gold report ID, else zero; source selection accuracy, not answer accuracy.
metric_definitions.evidence_accuracy_at_1: One if the first chunk individually covers any complete canonical gold source unit, else zero; annotated source selection accuracy, not answer accuracy.
metric_definitions.context_tokens_at_5: Sum of stored cl100k_base chunk token counts in the first 5 chunks, including overlap.
metric_definitions.returned_chunks_at_5: Number of chunks actually returned, at most 5.
metric_definitions.candidate_top20: The unchanged vector Top 20 pool. Its evidence Recall@20 is an upper bound on evidence Recall@5 achievable by selecting from that pool, not necessarily an attainable Top 5 oracle.

limitations: Agent-authored, source-checked labels await independent human semantic review.
Gold evidence is non-exhaustive; valid unjudged passages receive no evidence credit.
Retrieval accuracy and complete evidence coverage do not measure generated-answer accuracy; no answer generator is evaluated.
Summary coverage measures selected source claims, not completeness of a generated summary.
A fixed number of chunks is not a fixed context-token budget; context token counts include overlap.
Paired query bootstrap intervals are exploratory and ignore within-company and question-template dependence.

vector_query_manifest.inputs: question text only; no gold documents, evidence, answers, or filters

candidate_manifest.selection: First 20 unchanged candidates from the existing exact-vector ranking; direct baseline is first 5
candidate_manifest.model_inputs: Query text and render_document(original candidate) only; no answers, labels, or expected documents

benchmark_validation.validation_scope: Exact parsed source spans/full rows, claim links, source identity, and company-disjoint splits; not semantic answer accuracy or exhaustive relevance.
benchmark_validation.coverage_counting: Year/company counts include each distinct source year/company once per question; comparative questions can contribute to several companies.
benchmark_validation.memory_policy: Stream each source document; retain only gold-selected element/table fields, then release them.

preflight.policy: Score each complete query plus unchanged source chunk; fail before inference if any pair exceeds model capacity

scoring.timing_scope: One synchronized scoring pass per 20-candidate query after warmup, including tokenization/transfer/model scoring; excludes retrieval, model loading, disk checkpointing, ranking and evaluation

policy: Fixed requested BGE reranker, original vector Top 20 candidates and Top 5 output; no tuning on dev or test labels
